title: JavaScript and TypeScript: language, browser and Node applications
summary: 66 lessons in JavaScript and TypeScript, including a dedicated 24-lesson offline D3 visualization sequence. Progress from language foundations through browser behavior, typed applications, statistical graphics and accessible interactive dashboards.

lessons.title: JavaScript, Node and the browser
lessons.outcome: Identify the host running a module, separate language features from host APIs and await a real Promise result.
lessons.lab: Calculate 2+3 and compare the numeric result with a string.
lessons.verification: number 5; not strictly equal to string 5.

lessons.title: Values, coercion and precise comparisons
lessons.outcome: Predict coercion and equality results, expose floating-point approximation and reject ambiguous numeric input.
lessons.lab: Use NaN, +0 and -0 with strict equality and Object.is.
lessons.verification: NaN!==NaN; Object.is(NaN, NaN) is true; +0===-0; Object.is distinguishes zeros.

lessons.title: Control flow and loop boundaries
lessons.outcome: Write conditions and loops that keep valid zeros, handle empty collections and make an off-by-one boundary observable.
lessons.lab: Sum 2, 4, 6 and record the accumulator after each iteration.
lessons.verification: prefixes 2, 6, 12.

lessons.title: Functions, scope and closures
lessons.outcome: Write pure functions and independent closures, explain let versus var capture and validate a factory's configuration.
lessons.lab: Create three closures in a let loop and three in a var loop.
lessons.verification: let returns 0, 1, 2; var returns 3, 3, 3.

lessons.title: Arrays and immutable transformations
lessons.outcome: Transform arrays without mutating their input, supply safe reduction identities and avoid default sort coercion.
lessons.lab: Sort 10, 2, 1 with default and numeric comparators.
lessons.verification: default 1, 10, 2; numeric 1, 2, 10.

lessons.title: Objects, properties and prototypes
lessons.outcome: Distinguish own from inherited properties, copy objects deliberately and use null-prototype dictionaries for arbitrary keys.
lessons.lab: Read missing count and explicit null count with default 0.
lessons.verification: missing becomes 0; null remains null.

lessons.title: Maps, sets and collection identity
lessons.outcome: Choose Map or Set for identity-sensitive data, count events and tell a stored zero from an absent key.
lessons.lab: Build a frequency Map for red, blue, red.
lessons.verification: red 2, blue 1.

lessons.title: Strings, Unicode and regular expressions
lessons.outcome: Count and compare Unicode text correctly and write bounded, Unicode-aware regular expressions without hidden cursor state.
lessons.lab: Escape a.b+ and match it exactly rather than interpreting dot and plus.
lessons.verification: literal accepted; axbb rejected.

lessons.title: Errors and explicit validation
lessons.outcome: Validate parsed input explicitly, reject wrong shapes and unsafe numbers, and translate errors while keeping their cause.
lessons.lab: Try quantity 0, quantity 1.5 and negative price.
lessons.verification: RangeError for each.

lessons.title: Modules and dependency boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain live bindings, module caching and relative resolution, and diagnose a missing dependency in an ES module graph.
lessons.lab: Import one URL twice and compare the namespace and exported object.
lessons.verification: both namespace and object identities are shared.

lessons.title: Iterators and generators
lessons.outcome: Write lazy iterators and generators that close on early exit and validate their configuration.
lessons.lab: Consume one generator twice, then create a second generator.
lessons.verification: first pass is 0,1,2; second is empty; fresh pass repeats 0,1,2.

lessons.title: Promises and the event loop
lessons.outcome: Predict Promise and microtask ordering and combine Promises with all, allSettled and race correctly.
lessons.lab: Resolve the second deferred Promise first, then the first.
lessons.verification: result remains `['first', 'second']`.

lessons.title: Async functions and cancellation
lessons.outcome: Cancel async work cooperatively with AbortSignal and release timers and listeners exactly once, including with using.
lessons.lab: Run the custom operation without aborting, then abort its signal after completion.
lessons.verification: value 7; trace `started`, `completed`, `cleaned`, with cleanup exactly once.

lessons.title: Collections, search and algorithmic complexity
lessons.outcome: Implement lower-bound search and a binary heap, cover boundary cases and count comparisons instead of timing them.
lessons.lab: Search empty input, then targets below and above a sorted input.
lessons.verification: positions 0,0,3.

lessons.title: Testing with Node built-ins
lessons.outcome: Write node:test suites that fail on wrong results, await asynchronous checks and keep fixtures independent.
lessons.lab: Declare an async test that awaits Promise resolution before checking the value.
lessons.verification: child exit status 0.

lessons.title: Files, paths and streaming text
lessons.outcome: Read, write and stream UTF-8 files safely, refuse accidental overwrites and close file handles with await using.
lessons.lab: Create a file exclusively twice and inspect its unchanged content.
lessons.verification: second creation rejects with EEXIST; original first remains.

lessons.title: HTTP, URLs and JSON boundaries
lessons.outcome: Serve and request an owned local HTTP endpoint, encode URLs with the URL API and reject invalid query input.
lessons.lab: Round-trip a query containing spaces, ampersand and equals without contacting a server.
lessons.verification: the value round-trips as one parameter.

lessons.title: A reliable command-line data tool
lessons.outcome: Build a command-line data tool with a strict argument, input and error contract tested through a real child process.
lessons.lab: Send a valid first row and malformed JSON on line 2.
lessons.verification: exit 2; stdout empty; stderr identifies line 2.

lessons.title: TypeScript values and compile-time types
lessons.outcome: Annotate and narrow TypeScript values, explain type erasure and tell type stripping in Node from type checking with tsc.
lessons.lab: Use const for a fixed tag and let for a changing text value.
lessons.verification: fixed tag remains ready; mutable text can change to done.

lessons.title: Unions, narrowing and exhaustiveness
lessons.outcome: Model results with discriminated unions, narrow them safely and make a missing variant a compile-time error.
lessons.lab: Demonstrate that a failure branch cannot read value.
lessons.verification: expected compiler error on value; valid failure formatting remains unchanged.

lessons.title: Object types and structural contracts
lessons.outcome: Write structural object types and explain optional, readonly and aliasing behavior at runtime.
lessons.lab: Use a nullish fallback on an optional count.
lessons.verification: absent becomes 10; explicit 0 remains 0.

lessons.title: Generic functions and constraints
lessons.outcome: Write generic functions whose constraints connect inputs to precise result types without unsafe casts.
lessons.lab: Read the first item from a nonempty and an empty readonly array.
lessons.verification: 4 and undefined.

lessons.title: Mapped, conditional and utility types
lessons.outcome: Derive types with mapped, conditional and utility types and check configuration objects with satisfies.
lessons.lab: Define both conditional utilities and demonstrate their different assignment behavior.
lessons.verification: whole-union array accepts mixed values; distributed array rejects them.

lessons.title: Runtime validation and unknown input
lessons.outcome: Validate unknown JSON at runtime into trusted typed values and report precise nested failures.
lessons.lab: Parse malformed JSON and valid JSON null.
lessons.verification: codes json and schema respectively.

lessons.title: Typed modules and NodeNext resolution
lessons.outcome: Compile and run multi-module TypeScript under NodeNext and explain emitted extensions, type-only imports and specifiers.
lessons.lab: Assign text to a number in a fresh project.
lessons.verification: TS2322; nonzero compiler status; no compiled main.mjs.

lessons.title: Classes, composition and private state
lessons.outcome: Design classes with private state, injected collaborators and invariants that reject invalid transitions.
lessons.lab: Try a negative deposit and an overdraw.
lessons.verification: both throw; balance stays 100.

lessons.title: Typed async workflows and errors
lessons.outcome: Type async workflows that narrow results, translate cancellation and keep every batch outcome.
lessons.lab: Abort a real timer-backed operation.
lessons.verification: failure result cancelled.

lessons.title: Data structures and dynamic programming
lessons.outcome: Implement breadth-first search and dynamic programming that handle cycles, disconnection and unreachable amounts.
lessons.lab: Search A to C through A-B-A cycles and check source-to-source.
lessons.verification: A,B,C and A.

lessons.title: The DOM, events and accessible interaction
lessons.outcome: Build accessible DOM interactions with native controls, event delegation and listener cleanup.
lessons.lab: Create a new list item with button B after the listener is installed and activate it.
lessons.verification: the existing ancestor listener reports B without a new per-button listener.

lessons.title: Forms, browser storage and application state
lessons.outcome: Validate forms and persist versioned state in browser storage, handling failures and changes from other tabs.
lessons.lab: Reject malformed JSON or a stored version other than 1 before rendering.
lessons.verification: invalid saved state is diagnosed and does not become accepted application state.

lessons.title: Safe browser rendering and security boundaries
lessons.outcome: Render untrusted text and links safely and explain what a Content Security Policy does and does not block.
lessons.lab: Inspect the reference HTML and load its external script and stylesheet under the meta policy.
lessons.verification: local resources load; no inline handlers or eval are needed.

lessons.title: Streams and backpressure
lessons.outcome: Build stream pipelines that respect backpressure, propagate failures and abort cleanly.
lessons.lab: Use an async source that yields once then throws.
lessons.verification: pipeline rejects with source failed; sink is destroyed.

lessons.title: Worker threads and CPU-bound work
lessons.outcome: Move CPU-bound work to worker threads, transfer or clone data deliberately and handle worker errors and termination.
lessons.lab: Send an object, mutate the worker copy and compare the original.
lessons.verification: worker returns 9; parent remains 1.

lessons.title: Memory, performance and profiling
lessons.outcome: Measure performance with repeated checked samples and bounded event-loop observations without overclaiming.
lessons.lab: Populate and clear a Map while recording memory counters.
lessons.verification: entry count 100 then 0; valid counters, with no asserted memory drop.

lessons.title: Dates, internationalization and time zones
lessons.outcome: Handle instants, offsets, daylight-saving gaps and locale formatting without parsing displayed text.
lessons.lab: Accept leap-day 2024-02-29 and reject 2023-02-29, slash format and month 13.
lessons.verification: only the valid strict date is accepted.

lessons.title: Package design and reproducible toolchains
lessons.outcome: Design a package with explicit exports, detect tampered sources by digest and keep a versioned behavior contract.
lessons.lab: Attempt a package-name import of private.mjs even though the file exists.
lessons.verification: nonzero child status with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.

lessons.title: Network retries, idempotency and bounded concurrency
lessons.outcome: Retry network calls with jitter and idempotency keys, bound concurrency and honor cancellation.
lessons.lab: Submit the same key and payload twice to the local store.
lessons.verification: one side effect; identical returned receipt.

lessons.title: Typed API design and contract testing
lessons.outcome: Design a typed API contract with stable error envelopes and test that client and server agree.
lessons.lab: Use an unknown path and an unsupported method.
lessons.verification: 404 not_found versus 405 method_not_allowed.

lessons.title: Functional core and state machines
lessons.outcome: Model a job lifecycle as a pure state machine with a retry budget, terminal cancellation and deterministic replay.
lessons.lab: Fail three started attempts and try to retry once more.
lessons.verification: attempt 3 remains failed; further retry rejects.

lessons.title: A tested local JavaScript service
lessons.outcome: Build and test a local HTTP service that validates input before changing state and cleans up its listeners.
lessons.lab: Create A with value 2, then try A with value 9.
lessons.verification: second request 409; stored value remains 2.

lessons.title: A typed analytics pipeline
lessons.outcome: Build a streaming TypeScript analytics pipeline that quarantines bad lines and enforces input budgets.
lessons.lab: Use an emoji group and split every UTF-8 byte.
lessons.verification: group name remains intact with sum 7.

lessons.title: Release, observability and maintenance
lessons.outcome: Build, verify and run a release bundle that rejects tampered bytes and gates its runtime against an explicit policy.
lessons.lab: Replace one file entry with ../outside.txt.
lessons.verification: path is rejected before any outside file is read.

lessons.title: D3 and SVG: from a number to a visible mark
lessons.outcome: Map a count to the length of an SVG bar, place marks in a viewBox and label each mark with its value.
lessons.lab: Create three labeled bars from a saved blank pad.
lessons.verification: Exactly three rectangles with matching labels and counts.

lessons.title: Selections and data joins: enter, update and exit
lessons.outcome: Render with data joins so repeated draws add, update and remove exactly the marks the current data needs.
lessons.lab: Write a render function using a data join.
lessons.verification: Repeated calls produce exactly one mark per current record.

lessons.title: Keyed joins and object identity through updates
lessons.outcome: Use keyed joins so each mark keeps its entity identity through reordering, and reject duplicate IDs.
lessons.lab: Implement a keyed redraw with two records.
lessons.verification: Node identity and current data values both match expectations.

lessons.title: Scales: domains, ranges, inversion and honest baselines
lessons.outcome: Choose and configure linear and band scales, invert positions and keep an honest zero baseline.
lessons.lab: Build a scale-based bar chart.
lessons.verification: Bar geometry derives from a zero baseline and a named domain.

lessons.title: Axes, ticks, labels and numerical formatting
lessons.outcome: Build labeled axes with deliberate ticks and number formats that match the data's representation.
lessons.lab: Build a labeled quantitative axis.
lessons.verification: Visible quantity, units and correctly formatted tick values.

lessons.title: Data cleaning: CSV parsing, missing values and aggregation
lessons.outcome: Parse inline CSV, separate missing from invalid values and aggregate at an explicit grain before charting.
lessons.lab: Parse and aggregate the inline fixture.
lessons.verification: A totals to 5 and B totals to 4 from valid rows.

lessons.title: Time series: dates, sorted lines and visible gaps
lessons.outcome: Draw a UTC time-series line that stays in time order and shows missing observations as gaps.
lessons.lab: Build a UTC line chart with a gap.
lessons.verification: Time-ordered points and separate defined segments.

lessons.title: Scatterplots, size encodings and overplotting
lessons.outcome: Build a scatterplot whose size encoding is proportional to area and handle overplotted points.
lessons.lab: Build a three-variable scatterplot.
lessons.verification: Position and area mappings have named units and a size explanation.

lessons.title: Histograms, bin boundaries and distribution shape
lessons.outcome: Build histograms with explicit bin boundaries and explain how bin choices and densities change the shape.
lessons.lab: Build the explicit-boundary count histogram.
lessons.verification: Five bins with counts 1, 2, 1, 0, 2.

lessons.title: Statistical summaries, box plots and uncertainty intervals
lessons.outcome: Compute quartiles, draw a box plot and present interval estimates without confusing spread with uncertainty.
lessons.lab: Draw a labeled box and median.
lessons.verification: The box endpoints map to Q1 and Q3 and the line maps to median.

lessons.title: Grouped and stacked bars: totals, composition and denominators
lessons.outcome: Build stacked and grouped bar charts and keep totals, shares and denominators explicit.
lessons.lab: Build a two-series stacked chart.
lessons.verification: Segment heights match component values and total heights match row sums.

lessons.title: Reusable and responsive chart components
lessons.outcome: Write a reusable chart component with an explicit render contract, empty state and responsive sizing.
lessons.lab: Implement a reusable bar renderer.
lessons.verification: Explicit inputs, keyed marks and a documented empty state.

lessons.title: Transitions, interruption and reduced-motion design
lessons.outcome: Animate updates with bounded, interruptible transitions that await completion and respect reduced motion.
lessons.lab: Implement a bounded transition with completion checks.
lessons.verification: Final geometry is asserted only after the transition ends.

lessons.title: Pointer interaction, keyboard access and safe tooltips
lessons.outcome: Add pointer and keyboard interaction that share one action and render tooltip text safely.
lessons.lab: Build an accessible selection list beside the chart.
lessons.verification: Native buttons are reachable and reveal exact record values.

lessons.title: Brushing and coordinated views
lessons.outcome: Link a brush to another view by converting pixel ranges to data values and handling a cleared selection.
lessons.lab: Link a brush to a textual record list.
lessons.verification: The list and visual selection describe the same IDs.

lessons.title: Zoom, pan and rescaled axes
lessons.outcome: Implement zoom and pan that rescale axes from the transform and restore the original view on reset.
lessons.lab: Implement linked mark and axis zooming.
lessons.verification: Both use the same rescaled view.

lessons.title: Hierarchies and tree layouts
lessons.outcome: Turn nested data into a hierarchy and render a labeled tree layout with correct node and link counts.
lessons.lab: Render a labeled left-to-right tree.
lessons.verification: Links connect the matching source and target nodes.

lessons.title: Treemaps and area-based composition
lessons.outcome: Build a treemap from leaf values without double counting and judge when area suits the comparison.
lessons.lab: Render labeled leaf rectangles.
lessons.verification: Bounds are finite and widths/heights are nonnegative.

lessons.title: Networks, force simulation and reproducible layouts
lessons.outcome: Run a seeded, bounded force simulation on copied nodes and links and validate the graph before layout.
lessons.lab: Build a bounded three-node network.
lessons.verification: All positions are finite and every link resolves to known IDs.

lessons.title: Geographic data, GeoJSON and projection choices
lessons.outcome: Project GeoJSON points with an explicit projection and check longitude-latitude order and distortion.
lessons.lab: Render the synthetic point collection.
lessons.verification: One finite path per feature with descriptive labels.

lessons.title: Choropleths, rate denominators and missing geographic joins
lessons.outcome: Build a choropleth of rates joined by stable IDs, keeping zero, missing and invalid denominators distinct.
lessons.lab: Build a stable-ID choropleth join.
lessons.verification: Every feature is matched or explicitly listed as missing.

lessons.title: Canvas, rendering cost and spatial hit testing
lessons.outcome: Draw many points on a canvas at the right pixel ratio and hit-test them with a quadtree.
lessons.lab: Draw 100 bounded points and a textual summary.
lessons.verification: The Canvas is visible and the count is available as text.

lessons.title: Dashboard state, cross-filtering and reproducible views
lessons.outcome: Drive coordinated dashboard views from one state object with pure derivations and explicit denominators.
lessons.lab: Build two coordinated views from one state.
lessons.verification: Bars and summary report the same selected records and total.

lessons.title: D3 capstone: an accessible, tested analytical dashboard
lessons.outcome: Build and defend an accessible, tested analytical dashboard with independent checks and stated evidence limits.
lessons.lab: Build a complete accessible dashboard from a blank pad.
lessons.verification: Controls, marks, text values and summary agree.
